subject: Request: Shortfall credit & onboarding concession for NimbusCare
messages:
From: Anna Ross <anna.ross@nimbuscare.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscare.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: onboarding shortfall + temporary concession

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the pilot run last quarter — the integration team has been great to work with. I wanted to surface a problem on our side and ask whether Redwood can support a short-term concession.

What happened: our product rollout was delayed by six weeks which means our committed usage for the onboarding period will fall short of the figure in the MSA. We still intend to ramp to the committed level over Q1, but our initial invoices will be below expectations.

Ask: would Redwood consider a one-time onboarding credit to cover the shortfall plus a temporary discounted rate for the first 2 billing cycles while we finish rollout? Specifically, the procurement team is requesting a $30k onboarding credit + 30% discount for months 1–2.

Why this matters: we are asking our board for an accelerated PO, and some financial headroom here makes the execs comfortable to sign for the annual commitment. We prefer not to lose momentum on the deployment.

I appreciate that this is outside standard terms — open to alternatives (smaller credit + deeper short-term discount, or milestone-triggered credits). Can you let me know what you can do?

Thanks,
Anna Ross
Head of Operations
NimbusCare

Attachments: rollout-timeline.xlsx (internal)
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -08:00
Subject: FW: Request: onboarding shortfall + temporary concession

Team — forwarding NimbusCare's ask. TL;DR: they want $30k one-time credit + 30% off for first 2 months to bridge a rollout delay.

Background: NimbusCare is negotiating an enterprise annual commitment (projected ARR $1.2M) with a 12-month committed-usage schedule. The shortfall appears to be an operational delay, and they commit to hitting target within Q1. This opportunity is high strategic value (healthcare vertical, potential referral partner).

My recommendation (sales): approve a make-good that preserves cash margin but removes friction for PO signoff. Proposed options for finance review:
- Option A (preferred by sales): $25k onboarding credit + 20% discount months 1–2; require PO and signed SOW before credit applied.
- Option B (conservative): $15k onboarding credit + milestone-triggered 25% discount for month 1 only; requires ramp proof at week 8.
- Option C (full ask): $30k + 30% x2 (only if we get exec approval).

Impact estimates (back-of-envelope): Option A reduces first-year recognized revenue by ~2.1% but increases likelihood of full-year commitment. Attached is a quick calc and their committed usage workbook.

Request: Markus/Marissa — need finance/exec signoff if we go beyond $20k credit or >25% temporary discount. Jonas — FYI on go/no-go timeline from sales.

Next steps I propose: finance to confirm allowance threshold, then I will respond to Anna with approved terms and attach PO template.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: nimbuscare_committed_usage.xlsx (sales view)
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: FW: Request: onboarding shortfall + temporary concession

Lauren — thanks for the context and the numbers. I reviewed the workbook and ran a quick margin sensitivity. My notes:

- We should avoid a precedent of blanket 30% discounts; that is material.
- Given the strategic nature and high likelihood of full commitment, I am comfortable approving a one-time onboarding credit of up to $25,000 and a temporary discount not exceeding 15% for up to 2 billing cycles, subject to PO + SOW and a written ramp commitment (we should capture this in a short amendment).
- Anything exceeding $25k or >15% discount should be escalated to Finance leadership (Marissa) for CFO sign-off.

If Sales prefers to offer a larger short-term discount instead of credit, we can structure it as a contra-revenue capture over the first 2 invoices so accounting can amortize and monitor realization against ramp metrics. Please confirm which option you want to present so we can get Marissa's signoff where required.

Markus Klein
Dir, Finance Planning & Analysis
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Anna Ross <anna.ross@nimbuscare.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscare.com, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Shortfall credit & onboarding concession for NimbusCare

Hi Anna — thanks for the candid note and for being flexible on structure. After internal review we can extend the following one-time, conditional concession to support your rollout:

1) One-time onboarding credit of $25,000 applied to your first invoice upon receipt of PO and signed SOW.
2) Temporary billing rate adjustment of 15% off list for up to two billing cycles starting at first invoice.
3) Credit and discount are contingent on: (a) signed PO received within 21 days, (b) SOW signature, and (c) a two-sentence ramp commitment from your ops lead outlining expected weekly usage; if ramp stalls beyond week 8 we reserve the right to re-evaluate.

I have attached a PO draft and a short amendment that captures the above. If that works, please countersign the PO and return so we can get you into production. Jonas will schedule a quick check-in post-signature to confirm the rollout plan.

If you prefer a larger up-front credit instead of the rate adjustment, we can revisit but will need Marissa's approval for >$25k.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting you across the finish line.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: po-draft-nimbuscare.pdf, SOW-amendment-brief.docx
